mapper.sql: WHERE a.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND a.project_id=#{projectId} AND a.deleted=0 AND a.system_code=#{systemCode} AND (a.doc_code LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR a.doc_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%'))
mapper.select: SELECT a.id,a.project_id,a.system_code,#{type} AS asset_type,a.doc_code AS asset_code,a.doc_name AS asset_name,m.attachment_id,a.owner_id,a.created_at,a.updated_at FROM ${table} a LEFT JOIN dm_content_attachment m ON m.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND m.business_type=#{type} AND m.business_id=a.id AND m.sort_order=0 AND m.deleted=0 ORDER BY a.updated_at DESC,a.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT id,project_id,system_code,doc_code AS asset_code,doc_name AS asset_name,owner_id,created_at,updated_at FROM ${table} WHERE id=#{id} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND deleted=0
mapper.update: UPDATE ${table} SET system_code=#{p.systemCode},doc_name=#{p.docName},updated_by=#{p.actorId},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{p.id} AND tenant_id=#{p.tenantId} AND deleted=0
UPDATE ${table} SET deleted=1,deleted_by=#{actorId},deleted_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,updated_by=#{actorId},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND deleted=0
UPDATE ${table} SET deleted=0,deleted_by=NULL,deleted_at=NULL,updated_by=#{actorId},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND deleted=1
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM ${table} WHERE id=#{id} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND deleted=1
mapper.select: SELECT m.attachment_id FROM dm_content_attachment m JOIN ${table} a ON a.id=m.business_id AND a.tenant_id=m.tenant_id WHERE m.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND m.business_type=#{type} AND m.business_id=#{id} AND m.sort_order=0 AND m.deleted=0 AND a.deleted=0

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ${table} a WHERE a.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND a.project_id=#{projectId} AND a.deleted=1 AND (a.doc_code LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR a.doc_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%'))

SELECT a.id,a.project_id,a.system_code,#{type} AS asset_type,a.doc_code AS asset_code,a.doc_name AS asset_name,a.owner_id,a.created_at,a.updated_at,a.deleted_by,a.deleted_at FROM ${table} a WHERE a.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND a.project_id=#{projectId} AND a.deleted=1 AND (a.doc_code LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR a.doc_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%')) ORDER BY (a.doc_code IS NULL OR a.doc_code=''),a.doc_code ASC,a.deleted_at DESC,a.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT a.id,a.project_id,a.system_code,#{type} AS asset_type,a.doc_code AS asset_code,a.doc_name AS asset_name,m.attachment_id,f.file_name,f.content_type,f.file_size,a.owner_id,a.created_at,a.updated_at,a.deleted_by,a.deleted_at FROM ${table} a LEFT JOIN dm_content_attachment m ON m.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND m.business_type=#{type} AND m.business_id=a.id AND m.sort_order=0 AND m.deleted=0 LEFT JOIN att_file f ON f.id=m.attachment_id AND f.tenant_id=m.tenant_id WHERE a.id=#{id} AND a.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND a.deleted=1
SELECT id,project_id,system_code,doc_name,owner_id,deleted FROM ${table} WHERE id=#{id} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId}
SELECT project_id FROM ${table} WHERE id=#{id} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND deleted=1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dm_component WHERE system_code=#{systemCode} AND project_id=#{projectId} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND enabled=1
SELECT attachment_id FROM dm_content_attachment WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND business_type=#{businessType} AND business_id=#{businessId} AND sort_order=0 AND deleted=0
